requirements.evidence: Contract fully implemented: migrations with entities_slug_unique (database/migrations/2026_10_29_042102_create_entities_table.php:17) and entity_memberships_one_owner on the generated owner_seq (database/migrations/2026_10_29_042103_create_entity_memberships_table.php:22-28); models, UserRole, factories and both policies (app/Models/Entity.php:48, app/Policies/EntityPolicy.php:46); routes (routes/web.php:20-24); mount authorization (app/Livewire/Entity/Settings.php:26-32); session pick + audit log (app/Http/Controllers/EntityController.php:16-30); owner-only settings link (resources/views/livewire/entity/dashboard.blade.php:18-20); last-manager guard (app/Livewire/Entity/Members.php:91-95) and vanished-owner case (app/Livewire/Entity/Settings.php:72-91).

conventions.evidence: Follows most: #[Locked] entity (app/Livewire/Entity/Settings.php:17), #[Validate] email (app/Livewire/Entity/Members.php:18), generated-style migrations with down(), #[Fillable] attributes (app/Models/Entity.php:14), Blade components, {{ }} escaping, database-schema.md and CHANGELOG updated. Deviations: domain writes live inline in Livewire components instead of app/Actions (app/Livewire/Entity/Members.php:33,57,79; app/Livewire/Entity/Settings.php:35,45,61); targetMembershipId has no Livewire validation rule (app/Livewire/Entity/Settings.php:24 vs rules() at :103).

security.evidence: Every public action re-authorizes on the server (app/Livewire/Entity/Members.php:35,65,87; app/Livewire/Entity/Settings.php:37,47,63); bound entity is #[Locked] (app/Livewire/Entity/Settings.php:17); foreign membership ids are rejected (app/Livewire/Entity/Members.php:61-65,83-87); assignable roles limited to UserRole::manageable() (:67-70); transfer locks owner/target and excludes self inside the transaction (app/Livewire/Entity/Settings.php:72-94); all Blade output uses {{ }}; mass assignment limited to name/slug (app/Models/Entity.php:14). No exploitable weakness found.

tests.evidence: Broad Pest coverage of happy, unauthorized and tamper paths (tests/Feature/EntityMembersTest.php:111,217), DB invariants (tests/Feature/EntityModelTest.php:45,54), locked property (tests/Feature/EntitySettingsTest.php:93) and vanished owner (tests/Feature/EntitySettingsTest.php:191). Gaps: the audit log is fully mocked (tests/Feature/EntityPickTest.php:19-20) and route middleware for members/settings is only exercised through the dashboard test.

simplicity.evidence: Small components that reuse policies and Eloquent queries; duplication: the cross-entity guard appears twice (app/Livewire/Entity/Members.php:61 and :83), isManager is copied in both policies (app/Policies/EntityPolicy.php:51, app/Policies/EntityMembershipPolicy.php:44), and Dashboard re-derives ownership (app/Livewire/Entity/Dashboard.php:28).

readability.evidence: Clear names, short focused methods and consistent translated UI text. Nits: throwaway `new EntityMembership(['entity_id' => ...])` used for authorization (app/Livewire/Entity/Members.php:35-37); employee-visible controls (resources/views/livewire/entity/members.blade.php:14,48,64); misleading blank option (resources/views/livewire/entity/settings.blade.php:37).

scope.evidence: Core entity work is on task, but the diff also adds .github/workflows/deploy-dev.yml and .github/workflows/tests.yml (85 lines of CI/CD), which no requirement mentions and which duplicate pipelines already recorded in CHANGELOG.md:91-92.

issues.explanation: A new Hostinger deploy/smoke workflow is unrelated to the entities task and duplicates the deploy-dev pipeline already documented in CHANGELOG.md:91; it should not ship in this change.
A new CI workflow is unrelated to the task and duplicates the existing Pest gate recorded in CHANGELOG.md:92.
The skip_tests input (and the deploy condition on :33) lets a deployment bypass the Pest gate, weakening the project rule that tests are never skipped.

Domain writes (add member, role change, removal) and the entity save/delete/transfer in Settings.php:35-95 are implemented inline in Livewire components; conventions require one app/Actions class per use case with authorization inside the action.

targetMembershipId is public client input with no #[Validate] rule (rules() at :103 covers only name/slug) and is validated ad hoc with filter_var + abort, deviating from the project's Livewire validation pattern.
The cross-entity guard is duplicated at :61-65 and :83-87; resolving through $this->entity->memberships()->findOrFail($id) would remove the duplication and the 404-vs-403 existence leak.
addMember authorizes by building a throwaway unsaved EntityMembership with only entity_id, which is fragile; an explicit ability on Entity would be clearer.
Ownership is recomputed with membershipFor(...)->role === UserRole::Owner instead of reusing EntityPolicy::manageSettings, duplicating policy logic.
The add form and the role/remove controls (:48, :64) are rendered for employees too, so they see actions that always return 403; hide or disable them for non-managers.
The empty option of the ownership-transfer select is labelled "Administrador", which is misleading; it should read as a "select an administrator" placeholder.
The test fully mocks the Log facade, so it never verifies that the audit channel is configured or what gets logged; a Log::spy/assertion on the channel would be stronger.
Global helper functions declared in Pest files (also tests/Feature/EntitySettingsTest.php:14) risk name collisions across the suite; a beforeEach helper or dataset is safer.
isManager is duplicated in EntityPolicy.php:51; a single shared check would avoid the two definitions drifting apart.

review.summary: The change delivers the entity/membership data model, policies, session picker and the Livewire dashboard, members and settings pages with good server-side authorization, validation, DB-level single-owner enforcement and broad Pest coverage, plus the required schema-doc and CHANGELOG updates. It is not ready to merge as is: it also adds two unrelated CI/CD workflow files (one able to skip the Pest gate), and the domain writes sit inline in Livewire components instead of app/Actions, with a few smaller cleanliness nits.
